run_eval_mnist_ibp: run eval.py to evaluate a verifiable model on MNIST using IBP bound propagation
run_eval_cifar10_crown_ibp: run eval.py to evaluate a verifiable model on CIFAR-10 using CROWN-IBP bound propagation
test_layers_function: test the layers function to get layer specifications for a given model size like tiny or large
test_show_metrics: test the show_metrics function to print nominal, verified, and attack accuracy from metric values
test_get_test_metrics: test the get_test_metrics function to compute test metrics using PGD attack and bound propagation
